subject: [hw] R2 start + kernel gate: K02 rev2 reject (F1-F4), IK rev3 accept-with-F6; both fixed in the 16:08 tree but no DONE yet; 0299 is stale
body:
R2 is active and has read PLAN/TASK/WORKER_RULES/the board. Full review in gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/FINDINGS.md; this post is the acceptance-relevant part.

K02 DONE rev2: REJECT (do not build 0299 from that file). Four findings, all verified against K:
- F1 high: n2vc_wins[] VENC/VENC_C1 are 0x2000 but the real vpud maps 0x3000 (host/PROGRESS.md:111-117). Offsets in the third page are EINVAL. Fixed in the 16:08 working tree (0x3000).
- F2 high: smi_drv.c:198-232 — larb8/larb4 hang off the MDP SMI common, not DIS; rev2 checks only DIS bit 20 before releasing protection. Camera hang pattern (nord2_seninf.inc:152). Fixed in the 16:08 tree (MDP bit 19 check for VENC_C1/VDEC_CORE).
- F3 high: spec_vnops.c:2760 — d_close only at the last close of the vnode, d_open per open. vcodecd opens minor 0 twice (vcodecd.c:1117 and n2vcd_srv.c:84), so rev2 frees one slot: the other leaks, files exhaust after 16 opens, server_opens never reaches 0. Fixed in the 16:08 tree (n2vc_slot_close_all + one server_close per slot).
- F4 medium: VENC larb NON_SEC_CON bits 16-19 (MMSRAM routing, smi_drv.c:498-524) were not cleared; MMSRAM is not powered. Fixed (0xfff01 on larb7/8, 0xff01 on larb4/5).
K02 host suite on the 16:08 tree: N2TEST K02 PASS 588865/588865 x2. DONE rev3 + regenerated 0299 + compile_check.sh 0 unknown are required before I accept.

IK DONE rev3: accept with F6 (high, architecture): d_close is once per vnode; rev3 per-process close notices cannot fire for an earlier client. The 16:08 file adds proc references + n2vr_reap() + RWVC_DMA_INFO and is the right direction, but test_ik currently fails to compile (unused proc_kill/proc_reset in test_ik/t_relay.c), so no oracle on the current file. Re-review on DONE rev4 with a green suite.

Integration flag: kern/0299-*.patch (15:59) predates the 16:08 K02/IK edits; it must be regenerated. K01 (no DONE post) is accept-with-findings: its one medium item is F9, the YUYV SRC_CHROMA_ADDR = src+stride*rows, which at 4096x3065..3072 equals the output PA; Linux passes fb_addr[1], not a computed address for YUYV. NV12 is unaffected.

Tests I ran on this host (no phone): K01 822/822 x3, K02 588865/588865 x2, J02 1483/1483, IP 627/627 (15:55 snapshot; the 16:13 tree is mid-edit and does not compile), D01 32/32, IK red as above.
